=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2209-2212 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The added log output includes `enabled=${VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES_ENABLED}` even though that state is already guaranteed by the preceding guard.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this is redundant logging rather than a correctness issue; severity disagreement was not present.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2230 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The missing-manifest error message was changed to only say to create the manifest, removing the prior bypass guidance.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on whether the removed `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false` guidance was still valid, but the finding itself is the same change in error text; use the highest severity/confidence reported.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2209 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The autofix added `, enabled=${VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES_ENABLED}` to the debug echo, creating redundant log output.
  WHY: When this line executes, `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES_ENABLED` is always `"true"`, so the extra field adds no new information but changes the log format.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2230 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The autofix changed the error message from offering two recovery options to only one.
  WHY: Removing `set VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false` guidance makes the error less helpful for users encountering a missing manifest.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2212 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The log message explicitly states that template render mode is "enabled", but the message is printed before checking `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES_ENABLED`.
  WHY: If a user sets `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false`, the log will still output an internally contradictory "enabled" message, which is confusing.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2230 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The error message removed the instruction informing users they can disable template mode.
  WHY: Removing the `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false` guidance makes the system less self-documenting and forces users to look elsewhere for recovery steps.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2209 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Added `enabled=${VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES_ENABLED}` to the debug echo.
  WHY: The value is guaranteed to be `"true"` when this line executes, so the addition is redundant.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:22/22 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The error message removed the user bypass option.
  WHY: The old message included `set VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false`, while the new one only says to create the required manifest.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:22/22
  PROBLEM: The log message says template render mode is enabled regardless of flag value.
  WHY: This finding was later marked partially incorrect because the prior guard exits when template mode is disabled.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2212 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The log message redundantly includes `enabled=${VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES_ENABLED}` when the code already guarantees this is `"true"` at this point.
  WHY: The log is accurate but slightly redundant because the prior guard exits if template mode is not enabled.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2212
  PROBLEM: The log message now includes both the raw `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES` and the normalized `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES_ENABLED` values.
  WHY: This is a non-functional enhancement that improves observability; the message is accurate because an earlier guard guarantees the line only executes when enabled.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2230
  PROBLEM: The missing-manifest error summary was changed from suggesting users `set VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false` to telling them to create the manifest.
  WHY: Under the template-only design, disabling template mode triggers a separate hard-failure, so the previous suggestion was invalid.
- tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py
  PROBLEM: The test's embedded harness snippet was updated to match the corrected error message.
  WHY: Consistency with the new message was confirmed.
=== END FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
